string.text: Pfft! Nothing but rubbish. I'm getting sick and tired of that. Soon as something breaks, they run to me and start whining about it. Listen, you got any vodka on you? I'd, umm... you... want a nice scope? The best optics there is!
It's your loss. If you have some - come in, don't be a stranger.
Well, thanks! How nice of you. Now I'll have something to help me relax later on.
